A '''copper pickaxe''' is a [[Tools#Pickaxe|pickaxe]] of the [[Copper equipment|copper]] tier, crafted from three [[copper ingot]]s and two sticks. In Matcha Flavoured it is the first pickaxe that can mine [[hematite]] (iron ore) and [[native silver]], and the one players are expected to use for most of the early game.

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===
The copper pickaxe breaks pickaxe blocks at speed {{Value|Copper Pickaxe|miningspeed}}, faster than the vanilla copper pickaxe (5) and twice the speed of the [[wooden pickaxe]]. It has {{Value|Copper Pickaxe|durability}} durability.

It cannot harvest diamond ore, [[native gold]], obsidian, crying obsidian or ender chests: those blocks break at speed 3 and drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/non_mineable/copper.json}}</ref> An [[iron pickaxe]] is needed for gold and diamonds, and a [[diamond pickaxe]] or [[steel pickaxe]] for obsidian.

The pack also makes glass, glass panes, glowstone, sea lanterns and mob heads pickaxe blocks, so a pickaxe breaks them faster than a bare hand.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===
As a weapon it deals {{Value|Copper Pickaxe|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Copper Pickaxe|attackspeed}}.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[copper ingot]]s. As with all equipment in the pack, the repair cost never grows, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]], it can be melted down into a single copper ingot. The copper pickaxe is also the base item for the [[Shakudo equipment|shakudo]] and [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] upgrades at a [[smithing table]].
